title: Outside Income as a Signal: Evidence from Politicians and Voters
title_zh: 外部收入作为信号：来自政治家与选民的证据
authors: Carina Neisser, Nils Wehrhöfer
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how public disclosure of politicians’ outside income affects their behavior. We exploit a disclosure reform targeting German federal MPs and tax-return data in a difference-indifferences setup using unaffected state MPs as controls. MPs increase their outside income by 24%, driven by likely right-leaning MPs. A representative survey experiment uncovers that right-leaning voters interpret outside income as a signal of competence and hard work, while left-leaning voters associate it with weaker representation. Consistent with this, we show that newspapers cover right-leaning MPs’ outside activities more favorably. Our findings suggest that politicians strategically use public disclosure as a signaling tool.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了政治家外部收入的公开披露如何影响其行为。利用一项针对德国联邦议会议员的披露改革及纳税申报数据，在双重差分框架下以未受影响的州议会议员作为对照组进行分析。研究发现，议员的院外收入增加了24%，这一增长主要由倾向右翼的议员驱动。一项代表性调查实验揭示，右翼选民将外部收入视为能力与勤奋的信号，而左翼选民则将其与代表性不足相关联。与此一致的是，我们发现报纸对右翼议员外部活动的报道更为正面。研究结果表明，政治家会策略性地将公开披露作为信号传递工具。

title: The U.S. Mortality Crisis as a Preston Curve Reversal
title_zh: 美国死亡率危机：普雷斯顿曲线的逆转
authors: Ritikaa Khanna, Rourke O'Brien, Andrew C. Stokes, Atheendar Venkataramani, Elizabeth Wrigley-Field
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: U.S. life expectancy stagnated and declined in the 2010s despite continued growth in real per capita income. We use Preston curves to characterize this pattern as a change in the relationship between income and longevity. Using state-level data from 1980 to 2019 and county-level data from 2000 to 2019, we estimate population-weighted Preston curves relating life expectancy to logged real per capita income. From 1980 to 2010, U.S. states followed the classic Preston curve pattern: rising income was accompanied by rising life expectancy. Counties followed the same pattern from 2000 to 2010. From 2010 to 2019, however, states and counties continued to become richer while life expectancy stagnated or declined. The curves shifted right without shifting up and became steeper, indicating decoupling and divergence: increases in aggregate resources over time no longer produced broad longevity gains, and, in any given year, inequality in life expectancy by income grew. These patterns are robust to alternative temporal anchors around the Great Recession and to substituting education for income. They also appear across sex and racial groups. County-level decompositions are broadly consistent with arguments that longevity has fallen due to widely shared exposures to social deterioration, which may account for the Preston curve reversal. Collectively, we show that the recent U.S. mortality crisis reveals a weakening—and growing inequality—in the conversion of aggregate resources into longevity gains. We conclude that the recent U.S. mortality crisis could be understood not only as a story about particular causes of death, but also as a weakening of institutional and social translation.
abstract_zh: 美国人均预期寿命在2010年代陷入停滞甚至下降，尽管实际人均收入持续增长。我们运用普雷斯顿曲线将这一模式刻画为收入与寿命关系的转变。基于1980-2019年州级数据与2000-2019年县级数据，我们估算了以人口加权的普雷斯顿曲线，该曲线将预期寿命与对数化实际人均收入相关联。1980-2010年间，美国各州遵循经典普雷斯顿曲线模式：收入增长伴随预期寿命提升。2000-2010年间各县亦呈现相同趋势。然而2010-2019年间，各州与各县收入持续增长，但预期寿命停滞或下降。曲线向右平移却未向上移动，且斜率增大，表明出现脱钩与分化：随时间推移的总体资源增长不再带来广泛的寿命增益，且在任意给定年份，不同收入群体的预期寿命不平等程度加剧。这些模式在围绕大衰退的替代时间锚点检验中保持稳健，并以教育替代收入后依然成立。该模式同样存在于不同性别与种族群体中。县级分解结果与"社会恶化导致的广泛暴露因素造成寿命下降"这一论点基本吻合，这或可解释普雷斯顿曲线的逆转。综合来看，我们揭示近期美国死亡率危机反映出总体资源向寿命增益转化的弱化——以及转化过程中日益加剧的不平等。我们得出结论：近期美国死亡率危机不仅可被理解为特定死因的故事，更可被视为制度与社会转化机制弱化的表征。

abstract: The rapid expansion of high-speed internet has intensified concerns about how digital technologies affect early childhood. Using the staggered rollout of fibre optic to the home in Uruguay as a natural experiment, this column finds that greater lifetime exposure to high-speed internet reduces children’s scores in communication, problem solving, personal-social and socio-emotional skills. The effects are partly explained by indirect channels, through the displacement of valuable activities for child development and alterations in caregivers’ behaviour.

title: Concrete Interests: Paramilitary City-Building in Rio de Janeiro
title_zh: 具体利益：里约热内卢的准军事城市建造
authors: Pantaleão, Bruno
official: 官方在线 2026-06-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: How do armed groups reshape cities? This article argues that Rio de Janeiro’s milícias—paramilitary organizations, frequently led by current and former security officers,—govern territory through “build-to-hold” urbanization. Rather than simply extracting rents, milícias construct informal housing to expand captive populations that generate recurring income, electoral leverage, and political protection. Combining geospatial data on territorial control with satellite-derived measures of urban development from 2016–2023, I use staggered difference-in-differences estimators to show that milícia entry causes sustained increases in building density and height. These effects are absent in gang-controlled areas and persist in territories transitioning from gangs to milícias, indicating that densification is specific to the milícia governance model. I further show that increased construction does not increase formal housing prices or transaction activity, consistent with a system in which armed actors retain control over housing assets rather than integrating them into formal markets. The findings demonstrate how criminal organizations actively produce urban space in ways that entrench coercive authority and blur the boundary between criminal governance and state power.
abstract_zh: 武装团体如何重塑城市？本文认为，里约热内卢的民兵组织——通常由现任或前任安全官员领导的准军事组织——通过“建设-持有”城市化模式统治领土。民兵组织并非单纯攫取租金，而是建造非正规住房以扩大受控人口规模，从而获取持续性收入、选举筹码和政治庇护。通过将领土控制的地理空间数据与2016-2023年卫星衍生的城市发展指标相结合，我采用交错双重差分估计量证明：民兵组织进入会导致建筑密度和高度持续增长。这种效应在帮派控制区域不存在，而在从帮派过渡到民兵组织的领土中持续存在，表明密度增长是民兵治理模式的特有现象。我进一步证明，建筑增加并未推高正规住房价格或交易活跃度，这与武装行为体保留住房资产控制权而非将其纳入正规市场的体系特征一致。研究结果揭示了犯罪组织如何通过主动生产城市空间来巩固强制权力，并模糊犯罪治理与国家权力之间的边界。

source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking

abstract: We investigate monetary policy transmission and energy saving incentives in response to rising energy prices. We add energy in consumption and production, and energy conservation capital, to a tractable New Keynesian model with heterogeneous agents, unemployment risk, and nominal asset holdings. We find that monetary policy influences the energy conservation through both unemployment risk and asset returns; energy price shocks intensify monetary policy trade‐offs in terms of stabilizing inflation and output. A weaker policy response is beneficial in terms of agents' welfare despite higher inflation. The Ramsey policy predicts a strong rise in the policy rate with a decline afterward.

abstract: This article uses the township‐level data on welfare expenditure and provision gathered by parish officers in England and Wales at three points between 1776 and 1815 to illuminate regional and local differences during the period. These data have been linked to geographic information system (GIS) mapping systems, facilitating the mapping of parish/township level welfare data across a wide range of variables. Appropriate linkage to the 1801 and 1811 census data and the 1815 income tax property valuations also permits new village‐level estimates of the prevalence, affordability, and typology of welfare provision. The results challenge current hypotheses about regional differences in how the Poor Law was administered.

title: Counterfactual Analysis for Structural Dynamic Discrete Choice Models
title_zh: 结构动态离散选择模型的反事实分析
authors: Myrto Kalouptsidi, Yuichi Kitamura, Lucas Lima, Eduardo Souza-Rodrigues
official: 官方发布 2026-05-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Discrete choice data allow researchers to recover differences in utilities, but these differences may not suffice to identify policy-relevant counterfactuals of interest. In fact, in the case of dynamic discrete choice models, only a narrow set of counterfactuals are point-identified. In this paper, we explore how much one can learn about counterfactual outcomes of interest within this framework. We focus on the partial identification of counterfactuals, while allowing for (mild) model restrictions that can gradually shrink the identified set. We derive bounds for low-dimensional objects (such as average welfare) as arguments of optimization programmes, along with a uniformly valid inference procedure. Furthermore, we develop new and tractable computational tools and algorithms suitable for dealing with high-dimensional problems like this. Finally, we illustrate in Monte Carlos, as well as an empirical exercise of firms’ export decisions, the informativeness of the identified sets, and we assess the impact of (common) model restrictions on results.
abstract_zh: 离散选择数据使研究者能够恢复效用差异，但这些差异可能不足以识别政策相关的反事实结果。事实上，在动态离散选择模型中，仅有一小部分反事实结果能被点识别。本文探讨了在此框架下，我们能对感兴趣的反事实结果了解到何种程度。我们聚焦于反事实的部分识别，同时允许（温和的）模型约束逐步缩小识别集。我们推导了低维对象（如平均福利）作为优化问题参数的边界，并提供了统一有效的推断方法。此外，我们开发了适用于处理此类高维问题的新型可计算工具与算法。最后，通过蒙特卡洛模拟以及企业出口决策的实证研究，我们展示了识别集的信息量，并评估了（常见）模型约束对结果的影响。
